blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) opens its 40th shopping mall in Antique

Present during the grand opening are (from left to right ) San Jose Vice Mayor Elmer Untaran, Robinsons Malls General Manager Arlene G. Magtibay, Antique Governor Rhodora Cadiao, RLC President Frederick D. Go, Antique Mayor Rony Molina, Robinsons Retail Group President Robina Gokongwei Pe and former Antique Governor Exequiel Javier.

Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) formally opened Robinsons Antique, its 40th shopping mall and, its 9th shopping mall in the Visayas. Located in San Jose de Buenavista, the capital of Antique Robinson Antique, a two-storey shopping mall is anchored by tenants Robinsons Supermarket, Robinsons Appliance, Handyman, Daiso and Quantum Amusement. The Mall which will house 60 tenants which will offer the same level of commercial conveniences found in Robinsons Mall's various urban retail destinations. The location is accessible from the town center and will have a transport terminal. RLC will be opening several more shopping malls nationwide before the year ends. Present during the grand opening are (from left to right) San Jose Vice Mayor Elmer Untaran, Robinsons Malls General Manager Arlene G. Magtibay, Antique Governor Rhodora Cadiao, RLC President Frederick D. Go, Antique Mayor Rony Molina, Robinsons Retail Group President Robina Gokongwei Pe and former Antique Governor Exequiel Javier.
